contact.title: پشتیبانی
contact.text: جهت ثبت تبلیغات و استعلام قیمت بنر به آیدی زیر در تلگرام پیام دهید:

downloads.notes: v9.1 — truthful ping: if a config shows a ping it connects; if it will not connect it shows no ping. Rock-solid tunnel.
changelog: A ping is only shown when the config is connectable — no more unstable badge or fake numbers
PING ALL starts at row 1, clears old results first, and measures every row fresh
Ping results survive app restart (Room is the store of record)
Tapping a Free config selects it for Home without leaving the tab
My Configs numbering is 1, 2, 3 on screen; COPY never carries a feed name
STOP goes through one controller; SOCKS/API ports are forced free before every start
Light / Dark / System theme; home banner decodes at the view size
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+), same signing key as v9.0

downloads.notes: v9.0 — STOP truly stops everything, the disconnect button always obeys, and every working config is visible the instant it proves itself
changelog: STOP now really stops: the background supervisor, the 15-minute WorkManager wake-up, feed fetches and leftover ping jobs are all cancelled the moment you press STOP — nothing keeps running in the background
No more rows stuck at Pinging… after STOP: the list clears instantly and all green configs sort to the top so you can see exactly which ones pinged
A permanent working-configs counter sits above the progress bar — it never disappears while the list has content, on both auto-search and manual ping-all
A config that proves a ping floats to the top immediately, mid-sweep, and stays there through every reload

The disconnect button always obeys: the auto-failover can no longer override your stop and reconnect to another server, a double-tap can no longer turn into an accidental connect, and a lost disconnect is automatically re-sent
Faster, honest sweeps: the same server listed under different names is no longer pinged 3-4 times, and dead configs no longer burn 24 seconds each (now 15s) — the progress line moves visibly faster
Fixed the connect/disconnect cycle leak: an orphaned core that held the VPN ports after rapid cycling (the cause of stops connecting after repeated use) is now cleaned up
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+), same signing key — installs directly over v8.9

downloads.notes: v8.9 — never degrades, never lies, never drops: week-one slowdown fixed at the root, every ping is fresh and real, verified connections heal themselves
changelog: The week-one slowdown is fixed: diagnostics ledgers, the discovery corpus, orphaned measurement rows and the probe-cap pressure latch are all bounded and released now — the app works the same in week six as in the first hour
Every manual ping is a FRESH real measurement: no more cached values, no more sweep starting mid-list, pings survive closing and reopening the app
The list keeps its order while pinging — rows test in place, then sort once at the end (no more jumping)
A config that pings green in Free is saved to My Configs immediately — no need to leave the tab
Home now always shows the config you picked in Free/My Configs the moment you return
A verified connection heals itself: if the server dies completely, the app switches to the best measured alternative and reconnects through the full proof gate
WiFi roaming and cell handover no longer stall the tunnel (same-type network changes revive it too)
Healthier links now automatically use the streaming-tuned profile (big buffers, long idle) — feeds and video start faster
DNS inside the tunnel has a fallback resolver — one flaky resolver no longer stalls page loads
Port catalogue expanded to 24 ports; the Ports and Fragmentation settings now genuinely affect the engine
Home banner shows the whole image at a proper height; light theme is fully legible (no more invisible button text)
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+)

downloads.notes: v8.8 — servers are always numbered (never real names, even on copy), WiFi/fixed-line fixed, faster discovery, no infrastructure identity in the app
changelog: Server names are never shown or copied — every config is numbered (Server 1, 2, …) the moment it enters the app, from one counter that never resets
Existing lists upgrade automatically: a one-time background migration renames everything already stored
WiFi / fixed-line internet fixed: no more TCP Fast Open on WiFi auto modes (fixed-line equipment silently dropped it and every handshake died)
Every WiFi network now gets its own measured profile instead of replaying another network's settings for 12 hours
The strategy the engine learns per network now genuinely shapes probing and connecting (it was a dead setting before)

Faster discovery: the adaptive probe controller now actually adapts, probes no longer time out while still waiting in queue, and failed configs cool down 30 minutes instead of being retried every cycle
The app contains no readable reference to its own distribution infrastructure
Home banner art now fills the banner exactly and renders at full sharpness
New ANR watchdog and safe-mode boot on top of the existing crash guards
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+)

downloads.notes: v8.7 — measurement truth: one real probe engine, database-backed lists at any size, per-network strategy, crash-proof upgrade
changelog: My Configs and Free lists now load through the database with paging — instant at any list size
One measurement engine for lists, auto-test and the connect button: a shown ping is a real, reproducible tunnel measurement
A single failed re-test no longer erases a working config (3 failures in 10 minutes before one is declared dead)
Upgrading with a huge config list no longer crashes — the import is chunked, resumable and backed up
The engine fingerprints your network (measured, never operator names) and learns which method works on it
Overnight auto-test survives process death (WorkManager supervisor) and advances cleanly through consumed sources
Network Settings rebuilt: 11 categorized screens incl. full DNS lab, diagnostics, strategy profiles, export/import
Per-ABI APK splits on the release page for smaller downloads

downloads.notes: v8.6 — disconnect actually stops the tunnel, ping requires proven payload, and the home connect button stays on screen
changelog: Disconnect now tears the VPN session down and cancels the notification
A sticky restart after stop can no longer bring the tunnel back by itself
Connected is only shown after a live device-path check, not a core-only delay
A ping is not shown if the throughput probe failed
The home log no longer grows under the connect button
Exit-IP summaries are printed once per IP/country, not on every resume
